whenToUse: Making the content itself stand out, such as products or photos.
There's only one thing to do on the screen.
whenNotToUse: You'd erase even the signals that things can be pressed.

alternatives.name: Flat Design
alternatives.reason: Making controls clear with colored planes.

accessibility: Keep the contrast of thin and gray text at 4.5:1 or more.
Even underlined buttons get a touch area close to 44px.
Even with wide spacing, lay things out so the reading order is clear.
